# Global Win Co. Ltd
> B2B exporter of rice, sugar, fertilizer, refined oils, and metals from Thailand since 2016.

Global Win Co. Ltd (GWINCOLTD) is a multi-commodity trading company headquartered in Yala, Thailand. We grow, source, and export certified agricultural products to international wholesale buyers, importers, and distributors worldwide.

## Key Pages
- /: Homepage — company overview and featured products
- /our-products/: Full commodity catalog with search and category filters
- /our-products/rice/: Thai rice varieties (Jasmine, Basmati, parboiled, glutinous)
- /our-products/sugar/: ICUMSA-certified refined cane and beet sugars
- /our-products/fertilizer/: NPK, urea, DAP, MAP, and specialty fertilizers
- /our-products/oils/: Refined vegetable oils for food and industrial use
- /our-products/metals/: Copper cathode, copper wire, aluminum ingots
- /about-us/: Company history, certifications, and mission
- /contact-us/: Wholesale quote enquiries and export contact
- /faq/: Frequently asked questions about commodity export
- /glossary/: Definitions of ICUMSA, NPK, FOB, CIF, and trade terms
- /privacy-policy/: Privacy policy

## Primary Topics
- ICUMSA 45 white refined sugar wholesale export
- Thai Jasmine rice (Hom Mali) and Basmati rice export
- NPK fertilizer and urea bulk supply
- Agricultural commodity trading from Thailand
- B2B wholesale export quotes (FOB/CIF)
- GMP, HACCP, Global GAP certified products
- Refined soybean oil and industrial metals
